newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-market soft wheat, barley.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-market soft wheat, barley.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted 230,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum rebate of 31.98 Ecus per tonne, a European grain official said.
The official also said the EU granted licences to export 91,200 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum rebate of 7.49 Ecus per tonne, confirming earlier trade reports.
Licences awarded via France covered the export of 85,500 tonnes of soft wheat and 135,000 tonnes of barley, a member country official later specified.
The EU rejected bids to export free-market Greek maize, the official said.
